Official document (PDF) · Draft S/11829 · Meeting record S/PV.1841

Resolution 375 (1975) of 22 September 1975 The Security Council,

Having examined the application of Papua New Guinea 49 for admission to the United Nations,

Recommends to the General Assembly that Papua New Guinea be admitted to membership in the United Nations.

Adopted unanimously at the 1841st meeting.

49 Ibid., document/11823
